Stocks Edge Higher Pre-Bell as Oil Eases

Market Wire · Mon, October 26, 2026 at 4:09 AM PDT · 1 min read

Wall Street futures pointed modestly higher pre-bell Monday as traders weighed easing crude prices, a heavy week of earnings and central bank decisions in the U.S., Canada and Japan.

S&P 500 futures rose 0.7%, Nasdaq futures gained 0.8% and Dow futures added 0.3%.
